Question ID: ENV_U02_L07_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.ECO.05

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Invasive Species and Biodiversity Loss
Stimulus: Invasive species case map/data

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the species or biodiversity measure. Then use the required stimulus (Invasive species case map/data) to connect the visible evidence to biodiversity change, extinction risk, and invasive species impact. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.ECO.05 and avoids the common mistake: counting only the number of organisms instead of species variety and ecosystem role.
